profile_text.body:
Colossyan is an AI-powered video and course creation platform aimed at enterprise training and enablement. The company describes its core product, Colossyan Creator, as a tool that converts existing documents, presentations, and briefs into structured video courses using AI agents, with users retaining editorial control over each scene before final publish. The platform includes more than 300 AI avatars and voiceovers, support for localization into over 100 languages, interactive elements such as branching scenarios and quizzes, team collaboration features, versioning without re-recording, and SCORM export for delivery through learning management systems.

The held facts identify Colossyan's product as falling within the video generation and editing category, with specific notes indicating AI video avatars, enterprise training focus, consent management, and UK-hosted infrastructure. No litigation, MCP servers, SEC filings, or patent records are associated with the company in the available data.
